structure: Part 2 of repos/trade-imports-ins-tests: the live-animals journey's party, address and transporter pages as the end-to-end suite proves them. Read in full: the 8 specs tests/animals/e2e/pages/{transited-countries,contact-address,permanent-address,private-transporter,commercial-transporter,transporter,transporter-add,transporter-add-save-cancel}.spec.ts, holding 56 test() declarations between them (transited-countries 11 in two describes, the second with javaScriptEnabled false; contact-address 11 plus 2 in a second describe tagged @address-book; permanent-address 5; private-transporter 2; commercial-transporter 4; transporter 11 plus 1 without JavaScript; transporter-add 7; transporter-add-save-cancel 2). The partition's per-spec counts (16/16/7/3/5/16/9/3) count test.describe, test.beforeEach, test.use and test.slow calls alongside the tests; the test totals are 11/13/5/2/4/12/7/2. Read as supporting context: the page objects page-objects/animals/{transited-countries,contact-address,permanent-address,addresses,party-picker,party-edit,transporter,transporter-add,private-transporter,commercial-transporter}-page.ts and page-objects/shared/{party-edit-form,address-picker-results,base-page,type-ahead,summary-list,journey-checks}.ts; the constants domain/animals/constants/{transit-countries-page,consignment-addresses-page,transporters,country-codes}.ts, domain/shared/constants/{journey-party-names,address-types,test-record-names}.ts and domain/ins/constants/{transporter-types,trader-transporter,trader-address,address-details}.ts; the flows flows/shared/address-book-seed.ts and flows/animals/journey.ts; fixtures/ui.ts and utils/transit-countries-assertions.ts. Covered: the transit countries page (route, heading, type-ahead search, add, remove, empty state, persistence, no-JavaScript path), the contact address page (headings, intro, controls, branch-address list, validation, the INS add-address hand-off, environment-dependent behaviour), the permanent address page (per-animal cards, the two options, the hand-entered fields, the HTTP 400 refusal and its messages, persistence), the transporter list (listing, approval-number column, search with and without JavaScript, validation, add), the transporter type question (options, warning, validation, redirects, status strip), the private and commercial add forms (titles, fields, banner, blank-save messages), and saving or cancelling an add. The party pickers and the shared party edit form are claimed from their page objects, because no test in this part exercises them beyond one consignor-picker assertion in contact-address.spec.ts; their own specs sit in the address-book parts, so the page size, the results count sentence, the 'Selected address' restatement and the Change and Remove actions are recorded as gaps for this part with the place they are proven named.
